title: NeighbourNet: Workflow Example
text: first perform quality control gene selection, prepare object NeighbourNet. Run PCA selected genes. Co-expression measured within gene set. Construct KNN graph used NeighbourNet. Optionally, data sets many cells (> 5000), can run regression subset representative cells. Finally, set regression problem compute local variance. NeighbourNet regression settings stored misc slot:
code: # Filter out lowly expressed genes and annotate TFs/targets/receptors/ligands genes <- NeighbourNet::select.gene(obj, min.cells = 10) obj <- NeighbourNet::prepare.seurat(obj, genes = genes$genes) #> Running Seurat scaling and PCA... obj <- NeighbourNet::prepare.graph(obj) #> Building KNN graph... # Not run obj <- NeighbourNet::select.cell(obj) # Local variance is computed for predictor and response genes. # Response genes are low-rank approximated. # Here we measure co-expression between TFs (predictors) and cell-cycle targets (responses). targets <- c(s.genes, g2m.genes)  obj <- NeighbourNet::prepare.reg(   obj,   predictors = genes$tfs,   responses  = targets ) #> Calculating local variance. Seurat::Misc(obj, "NNet.setting") %>% names() #>  [1] "pcs"           "loadings"      "p"             "nn.idx"        #>  [5] "nn.w"          "all.cells"     "all.genes"     "cells"         #>  [9] "predictors"    "responses"     "genes"         "lra"           #> [13] "scale.gene"    "nn.scale.gene" "nn.scale.pc"   "n.eff"

title: NeighbourNet: Workflow Example
text: Run NeighbourNet regression obtain per-cell co-expression networks. resulting network ensemble stored NNet.mod within misc slot. Build meta-networks summarising per-cell networks. Meta-networks stored (response × predictor × meta-cell) tensor:
code: obj <- NeighbourNet::run.nn.reg(   obj,   responses    = targets,   return.p.val = TRUE ) #> Return smoothed effect, can only generate networks for sampled cells. #> Return unpruned effect. #> Return p-value. #> Downstream analysis will be performed on the effect tensor. #> Downstream analysis will perform network pruning. #> Build the Laplacian operator. #> Now regress. # effect: (response × predictor × cell) tensor of co-expression effect sizes # p.val : corresponding significance tensor Seurat::Misc(obj, "NNet.mod") %>% names() #>  [1] "effect"        "p.val"         "meta.network"  "meta.response" #>  [5] "mus"           "sigmas"        "subsampled"    "smoothed"      #>  [9] "pruned"        "gene.sets"     "cells"         "defaults"      #> [13] "custom.y"      "w" obj <- NeighbourNet::build.meta.network(obj) #> Now construct the covariance matrix. #> Eigen decomposition. #> Non-negative PCA. Seurat::Misc(obj, "NNet.mod")$meta.network$meta.network %>% dim()

code: notch2.act <- act$receptor.act["NOTCH2", ] %>% as.numeric()  ggplot(pcs) +   geom_point(aes(component_1, component_2, colour = notch2.act)) +   scale_color_continuous("Act")+   theme_classic() +   theme(text = element_text(size = 15))+   ggtitle("Notch2") tf.cor <- cor(notch2.act, t(act$tf.act)) %>%   drop() %>%   sort(decreasing = TRUE) #> Warning in cor(notch2.act, t(act$tf.act)): the standard deviation is zero head(tf.cor) #>      E2F1      E2F2     SIN3A      E2F5      RFX1     ESRRA  #> 0.9801520 0.7602014 0.5186611 0.5018902 0.3693210 0.3544060 igraph::shortest_paths(   NeighbourNet::sig.graph,   from    = "NOTCH2",   to      = "E2F1",   weights = 1 / igraph::E(NeighbourNet::sig.graph),   output  = "both" )$vpath #> [[1]] #> + 4/9867 vertices, named, from 2d729a0: #> [1] NOTCH2 TRAF6  TP53   E2F1

title: Build Meta-Networks (Meta-response) via Network Embeddings (PCA / Non-Negative PCA) — build.meta.network
text: build.meta.network aggregates per-cell networks low-dimensional set meta-networks network embedding (nPCA vectorised networks). Concatenating network vectors yields edge--cell “long--tall” matrix. efficiency, edge dimension first embedded SVD/PCA, nPCA applied embedded matrix. accepts either Seurat object prepared NeighbourNet workflow precomputed 3D network tensor. Similarly, using build.meta.response, meta-responses representing functional gene modules can built nPCA embedding vectorised response profiles (cell*predictors--response). detailed arguments usage build.meta.network documented, build.meta.response alike.

title: Build Meta-Networks (Meta-response) via Network Embeddings (PCA / Non-Negative PCA) — build.meta.network
text: seurat.obj Seurat object NNet.mod list stored misc slot. list created run.nn.reg. provided, assay gene panels taken NNet.mod$defaults. Ignored network supplied. network Optional 3D tensor networks dimension order (responses x predictors x cells). supplied, return.p.val forced FALSE. k integer specifying ranks keep “long--tall” matrix concatenated network vectors. Limited min(k, n.response * n.predictor, n.cell). Default: 100. cutoff numeric value specifying p-value threshold ([0, 1]) passed get.network pulling per-cell networks. NULL uses defaults NNet.mod$defaults$cutoff. big.memory logical indicating whether load full network tensor internally reduce repeated reads. Default: FALSE. scale logical indicating whether scale single-cell network Frobenius norm across edges aggregation (per-cell normalization). Default: TRUE. truncated logical indicating whether retain significant edge embeddings (spectral-gap heuristic) running nPCA; otherwise, use exactly k embeddings. Default: TRUE. k < 100, set FALSE. n.net integer specifying number meta-networks output. Default: 20. non.neg logical indicating whether perform nPCA (iterative deflation non-negativity constraints) edge-embedded matrix, embeds cell networks nPCA loadings. Otherwise, embeds standard PCA loadings. Default: TRUE. max.iter integer specifying maximum iterations calculating nPCA component. Default: 1000. tol numeric value specifying convergence tolerance nPCA iterations. Default: 1e-10. return.p.val Logical; TRUE assay == "effect", also returns per–meta-network p-values embedding p-value tensor (NNet.mod$p.val) nPCA loadings. Forced FALSE network supplied non.neg = FALSE. Default: TRUE.

title: Build Meta-Networks (Meta-response) via Network Embeddings (PCA / Non-Negative PCA) — build.meta.network
text: Seurat object provided, update   NNet.mod$meta.network populated, , list containing: meta.network: Array size       (responses x predictors x n.net). p.val: Array (size) return.p.val = TRUE; else NULL. pcs: matrix PC scores learnt per-cell networks; rows = cells, columns = components. pca.loadings: matrix PCA loadings learnt per-cell networks. pca.sd: numeric vector singular values network covariance. npca.loadings: matrix PC scores learnt per-cell networks;                                 non.neg = TRUE; else NULL. scale, non.neg: Echo input flags. setting: Copy NNet.mod$defaults seurat.obj provided.

title: Build Meta-Networks (Meta-response) via Network Embeddings (PCA / Non-Negative PCA) — build.meta.network
text: Edge embedding: responses predictors size > 1, cell--cell kernel represents co-variation network structure across cells computed. Eigen-decomposition ran construct edge-embedding x cell matrix. one axis size 1, perform SVD directly (edges × cells) matrix. Rank selection: truncated = TRUE, simple spectral-gap rule tail singular-value differences selects working rank edge emebdding nPCA. Meta-networks: Project per-cell network onto first n.net directions (nPCA PCA) obtain meta-network slices.

title: Visualise Receptor–TF–Target Pathways on NeighbourNet Cell-Specific Networks. — visualise.network
text: function visualises NeighbourNet co-expression networks layered receptor–TF–target signalling diagram. takes pre-computed visualisation settings prepare.visualise , given cell meta-network component, builds multi-layer graph linking upstream receptors downstream gene modules. Edges weighted co-expression strength annotated prior GRN evidence, node shapes represented cluster-level pie charts. Interpretation NeighbourNet used build TF–target co-expression networks (example, targets responses TFs predictors), function provides prior knowledge enriched visualisation networks four concentric layers. innermost outermost layer, : g1 (targets): target genes, placed centre plot. g2 (TFs): transcription factors surrounding targets.         TFs grouped expression-based clustering (node colour),         TF assigned significance profile summarised pie chart         (fraction pie filled reflects likelihood         co-expression g1 targets). g3 (intermediate signalling nodes): optional intermediate         signalling molecules placed TFs receptors. nodes         represent shortest signalling paths connect receptors         TFs prior signalling graph. g4 (receptors): active upstream receptors         outermost layer. receptor linked TF inferred         mediate influence targets. Receptors coloured         accordance TF clusters, proportion colour fill         reflects relative activity expression. connections g1 g2 encode TF–target co-expression annotated prior gene-regulatory evidence. Edges represent three levels support: edge (significant relationship), dashed edges significant co-expression , solid edges significant co-expression also supported prior GRN evidence (different arrow styles indicating activation versus repression). g3 g4 layers summarise upstream signalling pathways exert strong influence observed TF–target co-expression patterns.

Co-expression g1 g2 extracted selected NeighbourNet assay (effect, p-value, meta-network) via get.network, associated p-values used define edge-specific significance measure. Node weights g1 g2 derived maximum significance incident edges can optionally rescaled scale.signifiance. Edge weights aggregated cluster-level pies, showing strongly layer contributes different g2 modules. evidence matrix NNet.visual.setting encodes prior GRN evidence g1–g2 pairs used annotate edges stimulatory inhibitory information available. show.pathways = TRUE, function also incorporates receptor–g2 prior (generated get.prior.model) signalling graph (generated get.gr.adj) construct upstream receptor layers. Receptor--g1 activity first inferred combining receptor–g2 prior model pruned g1–g2 co-expression network, weighted receptor expression selected cell component (check.receptor.expression). subset receptors (g4) intermediate signalling nodes (g3) chosen based activity shortest paths sig.graph, added outer layers layout. Finally, multi-layer graph laid using concentric layout, order layers controlled swap.layers radius, rendered via ggraph.
